title: Exploring the molecular mechanisms of Lrp/AsnC-type transcription regulator DecR, an L-cysteine-responsive feast/famine regulatory protein.
authors: Zhou, Zhiyou; Li, Zonglin; Li, Zhimin
one_liner_zh: 该文结合EMSA、丙氨酸扫描、MD模拟、PCA和分子对接，系统解析Lrp/AsnC型转录因子DecR响应L-半胱氨酸的别构调控及DNA结合机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作与动态机理，方法涵盖物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The Lrp/AsnC family of transcriptional regulators is commonly found in prokaryotes and is associated with the regulation of amino acid metabolism. However, it remains unclear how the L-cysteine-responsive Lrp/AsnC family regulator perceives and responds to L-cysteine. Here, we try to elucidate the molecular mechanism of the L-cysteine-responsive transcriptional regulator. Through 5'RACE and EMSA, we discovered a 15 bp incompletely complementary pair palindromic sequence essential for DecR binding, which differed slightly from the binding sequence of other Lrp/AsnC transcription regulators. Using alanine scanning, we identified the L-cysteine binding site on DecR and found that different Lrp/AsnC regulators adjust their binding pocket's side-chain residues to accommodate their specific effector. MD simulations were then conducted to explore how ligand binding influences the allosteric behavior of the protein. PCA and in silico docking revealed that ligand binding induced perturbations in the linker region, triggering conformational alterations and leading to the relocalization of the DNA-binding domains, enabling the embedding of the DNA-binding region of DecR into the DNA molecule, thereby enhancing DNA-binding affinity. Our findings can broaden the understanding of the recognition and regulatory mechanisms of the Lrp/AsnC-type transcription factors, providing a theoretical basis for further investigating the molecular mechanisms of other transcription factors.
abstract_zh: Lrp/AsnC家族转录调控因子在原核生物中普遍存在，并与氨基酸代谢的调控相关。然而，L-半胱氨酸响应的Lrp/AsnC家族调控因子如何感知并响应L-半胱氨酸仍不清楚。在此，我们试图阐明L-半胱氨酸响应性转录调控因子的分子机制。通过5'RACE和EMSA，我们发现了一个15 bp不完全互补的回文序列，该序列对DecR结合至关重要，但与其他Lrp/AsnC转录调控因子的结合序列略有不同。利用丙氨酸扫描，我们鉴定了DecR上的L-半胱氨酸结合位点，并发现不同的Lrp/AsnC调控因子调整其结合口袋的侧链残基以适应其特定效应物。随后进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟，以探讨配体结合如何影响蛋白质的变构行为。主成分分析（PCA）和计算机模拟对接揭示，配体结合诱导接头区域的扰动，触发构象改变，并导致DNA结合域的重新定位，使DecR的DNA结合区域能够嵌入DNA分子中，从而增强DNA结合亲和力。我们的发现可拓宽对Lrp/AsnC型转录因子识别和调控机制的理解，为进一步研究其他转录因子的分子机制提供理论基础。
